records.title: Bring you down
records.description:
Amid the rush of everyday life, the use of cell phones has become both a constant companion and a source of distraction. However, the incessant flow of notifications and the habit of endless scrolling present a significant challenge to modern existence: the excessive use of cell phones and its impact on emotional well-being. Never before have we been so connected and, paradoxically, so isolated—often accompanied by anxiety and diminished self-esteem.

It is within this context that the film produced by the Change1Habit initiative, from Unimed Vitória, emerges. The production invites the public to reflect on the consequences of digital dependency. Relying on a powerful visual metaphor, the film presents images of individuals with their heads bowed, evoking a mood of melancholy. Only later does the viewer realize that these individuals are simply absorbed in their cell phones. This symbolic device unveils an uncomfortable truth: excessive phone use can quite literally bring us down.

With sensitivity and emotional resonance, the film encourages a pause to care for one's mental and emotional health—not by demonizing technology, but by urgently calling for a rebalancing between the digital world and real life.

records.title: Burger King vs El pelado
records.description:
En el mundo de la publicidad, la creatividad y el ingenio son clave, y esta vez Burger King sube la apuesta con una campaña que promete dar de qué hablar. Bajo el nombre "Burger King vs. El Pelado", la marca invita al "pelado" a probar una hamburguesa de verdad, destacando su icónica parrilla como el sello distintivo de su sabor.
Lo curioso es que esta iniciativa llega pocas semanas después de que su competencia, McDonald’s, anunciara una nueva hamburguesa en colaboración con el reconocido chef Jorge Rausch. Con esta jugada, Burger King pone en el centro de la conversación su método de cocción a la parrilla y añade una dosis de humor al enfrentamiento publicitario.
La campaña "Burger King vs. El Pelado" se desplegará en redes sociales, medios digitales y puntos de venta, con mensajes que resaltan el sabor inconfundible de la carne a la parrilla y la autenticidad de las hamburguesas de la marca. Además, se espera que la conversación cobre vida con la interacción de los usuarios, quienes podrán sumarse al debate.
Con esta movida, Burger King vuelve a demostrar que en la publicidad, además de fuego, se necesita ingenio. ¿Aceptará el pelado la invitación? 



English:
In the world of advertising, creativity and wit are key—and this time, Burger King is raising the stakes with a campaign that’s sure to spark conversation. Under the name "Burger King vs. El Pelado," the brand invites "El Pelado" to try a real burger, highlighting its iconic flame-grilling as the signature of its flavor.

What’s interesting is that this move comes just weeks after its competitor, McDonald’s, announced a new burger in collaboration with renowned chef Jorge Rausch. With this play, Burger King puts its flame-grilling method at the center of the conversation and adds a touch of humor to the advertising battle.

The "Burger King vs. El Pelado" campaign will roll out across social media, digital platforms, and in-store activations, with messages that emphasize the unmistakable taste of flame-grilled beef and the authenticity of Burger King’s burgers. Plus, the conversation is expected to take on a life of its own as users join the debate.

With this move, Burger King once again proves that in advertising, you need more than just fire—you need creativity. Will El Pelado accept the challenge?

records.title: Butterheads
records.description:
Independent creative agency Another Thing recently debuted its first work for Vermont Creamery with a bold new brand platform, “This is Butter Culture” a campaign that repositions cultured butter as not just a premium food product, but a passionate lifestyle and community. 

The fully integrated campaign introduces a refreshed brand identity alongside a multi-channel rollout spanning film, digital, social, in-store and creator-led content. At the center is a simple insight: cultured butter fans are deeply obsessed with the product and proud to be a part of butter culture. 

Rather than lean into traditional food advertising tropes, Another Thing built a platform that celebrates the personalities, rituals and creativity surrounding food culture today. The campaign reframes “cultured butter” into “butter culture” inviting in a broader world of chefs, home cooks, entertainers and food lovers who see butter as both ingredient and identity.

New this week, Vermont Creamery is partnering with food creators already known for genuinely loving butter, or as the brand calls them, ‘Butter Heads.’ To surprise them, Another Thing commissioned a food stylist and sculptor to create hyper-detailed butter sculptures of each creator, literally transforming them into ‘Butter Heads.’ Because that’s who Butter Culture is for: butter-loving butter heads. The result is influencer content that feels visually unexpected and truly rooted in their genuine fandom rather than traditional endorsement. Check them out below:

Tess Sinatro
Dan Pelosi
Jake Cohen

“For some people, butter is just an ingredient. But for others it’s an obsession, a way of life, the most important thing in their fridge or on their table. So rather than just describe how delicious Vermont Creamery’s cultured butter is, we created a campaign that celebrated a whole new butter culture,” said Nick Kaplan CCO of Another Thing. “Sneakers have sneakerheads. The Grateful Dead has Deadheads. Now we have the newest super fan: Butterheads. And what better way to honor these Butterheads than by turning their heads into actual butter?”

records.title: You Impressions
records.description:
Glossier You’s “You Impressions” is a vivid new campaign produced by Cadence Films and directed by Mitch Ryan. The ad highlights Glossier You’s two fragrance additions, or ‘skin-scent enhancers,’ Rêve and Doux. Ryan sets a unique tone for each within the ad through intimate camera angles and an atmospheric soundscape. In addition to DP Sean Price Williams’ moody footage, Ryan personally shot GoPro coverage for the campaign before ever setting foot on set, lending a dynamic, avant-garde feeling to the film.

You Doux is a serene and woody scent of violet, palo santo, frankincense, and myrrh. You Rêve is a lush fever dream of buttercream, plum, almond, iris, and sandalwood; both are heightened by the musky base of Ambrox. Designed to grow and evolve with the wearer across time and space, these skin-scent enhancers smell a little different on each person. According to Glossier, “You are the final ingredient.” 

Mitch Ryan is a New York-based director known for stripping away the edifice and pretension to portray subjects in a raw, yet stylized, manner. Complex, full of emotion, and oftentimes humorous, he has worked with brands including Nike, Colina Strada, and Stussy and artists including Rosalía and Olivia Rodrigo. 

About Cadence Films
Cadence Films is an international production company, with offices in New York and Paris, rooted in advertising, and specializing in luxury, fashion, and beauty. For over a decade, they have intentionally connected inspired filmmakers with visionary agencies and clients, bringing big ideas to life.

With football season in full swing - and fans glued to hours of games and ads, especially on Thanksgiving, one of the most-watched game days of the year - Ryan Reynolds and Aviation American Gin dropped one thing no one asked for: a jingle you won’t be able to get out of your head [inspired by a certain iconic commercial we all know a little too well].
Introducing: 1-84-Gin-4-Fanz, a tune we’re sure will become your least favorite earworm. Reynolds stars in the spot alongside a cheerful band who sings “you’ll never forget Gin-4-Fanz but drinking gin might help.”

All season long, Aviation American Gin is encouraging fans to stay stocked for game day – because hard hits require soft landings.

records.title: Castin’ the Cowboy
records.description:
After weeks of taco ballads, big belt buckles and taco-fueled performances, Old El Paso’s wildly flavorful “Castin’ the Cowboy” content series has officially come to a close, with Keith Urban crowning a new taco night icon: Elroy, a larger-than-life cowboy with the chops to match his charm.

Elroy won hearts and caught the attention of Urban himself, with his Tex-Mex swagger, vocal flair and undeniable passion for Old El Paso. From fake horses to real harmonies, Elroy brought the heat and the humor to prove he’s more than just a cowboy — he’s the voice of taco night.

Elroy is stepping into the spotlight with a new ad campaign rolling out this summer, starting off with him taking the reins as the new cowboy. Then, stay tuned for more ad spots from Elroy coming this fall. The creative recognises the chaos of modern-day life, but shows how Old El Paso is one thing you can count on, bringing comfort, flavour, and a sense of ease back to the table. Whether it’s crunchy Stand 'N Stuff shells, Creamy Queso sauce, Original Taco Seasoning, or crowd-pleasing dinner kits, Elroy’s here to remind us that a little joy and a good taco can go a long way.

“When we launched ‘Castin’ the Cowboy,’ our goal was to celebrate the spirit of taco night in a way only Old El Paso can,” said Jenny Jonker, Brand Experience Manager at Old El Paso. “From our bold flavours to our versatile lineup of kits, shells, sauces and seasonings, we're all about making mealtime memorable, and bringing back our singing cowboy was just the beginning. Fans will want to keep an eye out for where Elroy shows up next!”

The full “Castin’ the Cowboy” content series, as well as plenty of Tex-Mex mealtime inspiration, can be found @OldElPaso on Instagram and @OldElPaso_Official on TikTok.

records.title: Catio, Bowling
records.description:
The 55+ crowd has more time to pursue their hobbies than the rest of us, but they also need their technology to be easy to comprehend and don’t want to pay for anything unnecessary. A new campaign from Consumer Cellular and its AOR, THE MAYOR, shows the benefits of a flexible wireless carrier for its customers. 

Bringing back Sam, the personification of the award-winning customer service offered by Consumer Cellular, the campaign brings relatable and humorous scenarios to life, touting the value the wireless carrier does best without the hefty price tag. 

To help launch the new Apple iPhone 16 on Consumer Cellular, the first spot, ‘Catio’, debuts Apple Intelligence as a relevant tool for the 55+ audience.

Launched earlier this month across streaming services, ‘Catio’ takes us into the world of retired cat parents who want to save money on their wireless plan while keeping the quality they expect from their cell carrier. After all, custom catios aren’t cheap.

The approach to combine two timely concepts like catios and AI is a perfect delivery to show audiences a couple in their prime years utilizing AI, rather than a stereotypical scenario like bike riding or gardening.

The second spot, ‘Bowling’, amplifies Consumer Cellular’s award-winning customer service and affordability, which landed them #1 in network coverage in a recent ranking. 

‘Bowling’ shows two friends at a bowling alley practicing their striking throws, one a CCI customer and the other left with lacking cell service. Friendly competition leads the CCI customer to convince her friend to switch carriers for the low price of $20 a month, leaving enough in the budget for some much-needed bowling lessons.

THE MAYOR has worked in partnership with Consumer Cellular, Inc. since early 2024 to support the brand in their mission to be the most beloved wireless company in the nation. 

This latest campaign complements THE MAYOR’s previous efforts supporting Consumer Cellular’s campaigns with Ted Dansen, NASCAR, as well as other broadcast and activation work including ‘Shot on Flip Phone’, which launched earlier this year.

records.title: Celebrating Pet People
records.description:
Drontal, the trusted name in parasite protection for cats and dogs, has unveiled a new pan-European campaign that puts pet people firmly at the heart of the story. Created by award-winning branding agency WMH&I, the campaign empowers owners to feel in control of parasite protection while celebrating the gloriously messy, joyful reality of life with pets.
Celebrating Real Pet Life
Life with pets is never picture-perfect. From split poo bags to muddy paw prints on freshly cleaned floors, pet people understand that chaos is part of the joy. The new Drontal campaign embraces these everyday truths, showing pets living their best lives while their humans do their best to keep up.
This unapologetic celebration of pet life positions Drontal as the pet people’s champion: offering fuss-free, trusted parasite protection, while owners handle everything else that comes with loving their companions.
The campaign’s strategy is rooted in the simple insight that pet people wouldn’t change the realities of pet ownership for the world. By championing these relatable, often unglamorous moments, Drontal demonstrates its commitment to being on the side of real pet people. Those who go above and beyond to ensure their pets’ health and happiness.
A Trusted Partner for Pet People
The campaign rolls out across TVC, point-of-sale, and out-of-home platforms, spanning key European markets including the UK, Poland, Italy, and France. Each execution brings to life the bond between pets and their people through a series of lively, humorous vignettes. From dogs commandeering the sofa to cats ruling the kitchen table, the creative showcases that while pets may run the show at home, Drontal ensures owners can confidently take control of parasite protection.
“Pet people already juggle the daily ups and downs of life with their furry companions,” said Mark Nichols, Creative Director WMH&I. “Drontal takes one worry off their list by providing parasite protection that’s as reliable as it is hassle-free. This campaign is about recognising and celebrating them — the unsung heroes of pet life.”
With this bold creative direction, Drontal cements itself as not only the professional choice in parasite care, but also the brand that truly understands and champions pet people.

records.title: Chameleon
records.description: Debuting this week is an all-new Tootsie Roll television commercial featuring Tootsie’s iconic Mr. Owl. Only this time, he is being joined by a new color-changing chameleon to help showcase the chewy variety of Tootsie Roll flavors – cherry, orange, lemon, lime and vanilla, in addition to chocolate. The advertising represents a milestone moment as it’s the first time Mr. Owl has been seen enjoying a Tootsie Roll, rather than his past favorite – a Tootsie Pop. It also marks the next chapter in the Mr. Owl story – all designed to help create awareness around Tootsie’s full flavor lineup. Creative was led by Chicago-based indie agency Schafer Condon Carter (SCC), with illustration and animation handled by acclaimed studio Calabash. “Chameleon” will run in 30 and 15-second lengths beginning this week (June 15). It will be seen on Connected TV, YouTube and social media platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and Reddit, reaching Tootsie fans wherever they tune in.

records.title: Change the Equation
records.description:
Droga5 (a part of Accenture Song) is kicking off a whole new trajectory for Essentia Water and ditching the premium water playbook. Ahead of the crucial summer hydration season, Essentia Water is scaling its edgy "Change the Equation" platform from a localized strategy into a massive, omnichannel national rollout. Anchoring the campaign is "Beat the Formula," a cinematic anthem film directed by Ryan Chun (Magna Studios) in partnership with Droga5, a part of Accenture Song. The high-adrenaline spot captures the split-second decisions where athletes across seven disciplines choose instinct over instruction. It’s a visual manifestation of the brand’s 'risk over resignation' ethos, and will be amplified heavily across NY, LA, and Miami via a robust mix of OOH, DOOH, streaming, and TikTok. 

Plus, to ground the national rollout in authentic sports culture, Essentia is also rolling out a blockbuster partnership with global soccer icon Son Heung-Min. Marking his first U.S. brand partnership since joining LAFC, Son stars in a dedicated :30 spot and interview series that perfectly embodies the hustle of rewriting your own narrative. The 360-degree integration also includes a BMO stadium takeover, retail, and social sweeps. 

“Transitioning the 'Change the Equation' platform from a localized strategy to a nationwide rollout marks a pivotal evolution for Essentia Water,” said Katharine Weiss, Marketing Director of Essentia Waters. “We aren’t just expanding our footprint; we are scaling a brand POV that challenges the status quo of the premium water category. By deploying a robust, omnichannel ecosystem—from cinematic film to TikTok content—we are meeting high-achievers at every touchpoint of their hustle, providing the supercharged hydration they need to choose risk over resignation this summer and beyond." “The bottled water category often talks about purity. 

We wanted to talk about possibility,” said Tom McQueen, Executive Creative Director, Droga5. ‘Change the Equation’ is about empowering people to believe the outcome is never fixed and their choices can fundamentally alter it. Here risk is not an optional extra, it’s an essential ingredient.”

records.title: Chazmo Finally Goes Home
records.description:
Just days before football’s biggest night, Totino’s Pizza Rolls is unveiling its first-ever Big Game commercial “Chazmo Finally Goes Home”, featuring the return of comedic duo Tim Robinson and Sam Richardson as they plan to say farewell to Chazmo, their out-of-this-world, pizza roll-loving friend. 

Written by Zach Kanin (“I Think You Should Leave” and “Detroiters”) and directed by Alice Mathias (“I Think You Should Leave”), the acclaimed comedic team is dishing their signature humor in celebration of the most snackable pizza in the universe.

“Fans can tune in on game day to see their favorite Totino’s Pizza Rolls and favorite Detroiters like they’ve never seen before,” said Tim Robinson. 

“Chazmo Finally Goes Home” marks the first Big Game ad ever for the frozen pizza category and General Mills’ return to the Big Game after more than a decade. This unforgettable moment for pizza and football fans alike is part of the Totino’s Pizza Rolls overall strategy to help take the beloved Midwestern brand from regional darling to everyone’s favorite way to eat pizza coast to coast.  

Tim and Sam first teamed up with Totino’s Pizza Rolls last fall for “Chazmo Goes Home” where they starred as suburban dads and introduced fans to the intergalactic visitor Chazmo, who had become friends with their kids and ate all of their pizza rolls.

“I never got to really know Chazmo, but at least I got to spend the time enjoying Totino’s Pizza Rolls,” said Sam Richardson.

“Chazmo Finally Goes Home” features the conclusion to Tim and Sam’s farewell to Chazmo. In a humorous and unexpected twist, and with a bag of his beloved Totino's Pizza Rolls in hand, Chazmo's heartfelt farewell is abruptly interrupted, leaving Tim and Sam in shock and hilariously scrambling to maintain composure. 
“Totino’s Pizza Rolls promised fans a humorous, memorable Big Game ad debut, and we’re delivering,” said Blake Holman, Business Unit Director, Totino's. “We’re proud to partner with Tim, Sam, Zach, and Alice to create an ad that will leave you hungry for more from the brand as we continue to expand nationally.” 
Totino’s Pizza Rolls is also bringing back “Hang Time,” its first Spanish-language ad for the Big Game. The spot will air as a separate Spanish-language ad on Fox Deportes and Telemundo during February’s Big Game.  

“Chazmo Finally Goes Home” was brought to life by General Mills in partnership with Dentsu Creative, UM, Edelman, and The Social Lights. Fans can stock up on Totino’s Pizza Rolls ahead of Sunday’s game and check out the spot now on YouTube, plus follow along for more fun by visiting Totinos.com and keeping up with @Totinos on Instagram.

records.title: Chazmo's Back
records.description:
Totino’s Pizza Rolls is launching something special just in time for football’s biggest night — and yes, Chazmo, the out-of-this-world, pizza roll-loving pal who stole the show during last year’s Big Game, is back! 

This year, Totino’s is giving fans another look at the character they couldn’t get enough of. Before the full announcement gets revealed later this month, the universe’s most snack-obsessed being is back to stir up more chaos (and cravings) with a teaser hinting at what’s to come without giving away where (or how) he’ll land. 
 
Shot in quick mock-documentary style, the teaser features confessional interviews with cast members gearing up to work with Chazmo — part legend, part diva, all mystery. Just when anticipation peaks… Chazmo enters. It’s unpredictable. It’s dramatic. It’s very Chazmo.

records.title: ChemDraw Turns 40
records.description:
To mark the 40th anniversary of ChemDraw, the iconic molecular drawing software from Revvity Signals, a division of Revvity, Inc., Copacino Fujikado—an award-winning creative and media agency based in Seattle—has launched a new campaign that brings chemistry to life in a way that’s never been seen before.
“ChemDraw has been the visual language of chemistry for 40 years,” said Vince Soliven, Executive Creative Director at Copacino Fujikado. “It’s how scientists sketch out the impossible—and when a breakthrough hits, it’s not just a mental high. Sometimes your body gets possessed by joy. Our concept taps into that rush—that moment when the desk turns into a dance floor."
The “ChemDraw Turns 40” campaign, developed and executed by Copacino Fujikado in collaboration with Revvity Signals, captures the feeling of discovery and celebrates the software’s legacy—and its future—as a creative tool for scientists worldwide.
“We’re not just celebrating a legacy,” said Nathan Mosack, Revvity Signals. “For 40 years, ChemDraw has been helping scientists choreograph their thinking, one structure and one step at a time. Now, we’re turning up the tempo.”
Launched July 17 on LinkedIn and YouTube, the campaign features vibrant, playful creative that moves to the rhythm of scientific discovery. While the work of chemists might happen behind a screen, Copacino Fujikado’s concept imagines a world where molecules spin, electrons groove, and scientists two-step their way to eureka moments.

From undergrad labs to cutting-edge pharma, ChemDraw has been a mainstay in the chemistry community since 1985. What began as a simple sketching tool is now a powerful platform available in three tiers—Prime, Professional, and Signals ChemDraw—featuring 3D modeling, biomolecule design, AI-enhanced predictions, and full integration with the Revvity Signals ecosystem.
This campaign adds to Copacino Fujikado’s growing list of creative successes, including its recent global advertising win for Visit Seattle.

records.title: Chew Bold
records.description:
Stimorol launches new “Chew Bold” brand platform with film starring a boxing sloth.

Perfetti Van Melle chewing gum brand, Stimorol, is targeting Gen-Zers with a new platform, “Chew Bold.” Created by AMV BBDO, the platform launches with a film of a boxing sloth, directed by Emmy-winning and Grammy-nominated director Jake Scott at RSA.

Inspired by Gen Z’s belief that you don’t need to blend in to belong, “Chew Bold” encourages audiences to be confident, carefree and true to yourself, no matter who you’re with or where you are.

The “Chew Bold” platform is embodied by the sloth who stars in the launch film. Not fitting the stereotype of a fitness fiend, he’s working the speedbag like a pro. Having finished his workout, he cooly nods at curious gymgoers and nonchalantly saunters to the door. As our sloth leaves the gym it’s revealed he is actually human 20-something who Chews Bold and doesn’t need to blend in to belong.

“Chew Bold” marks a key milestone in Perfetti Van Melle’s ongoing strategic investment in growing and modernising its gum portfolio and is the first major new brand campaign and platform for Stimorol since Perfetti Van Melle took ownership of the brand in late 2023 as part of its acquisition of Mondelēz International’s gum business in the US, Canada and Europe.

Ana Khmiadashvili, Global Marketing Manager at Perfetti Van Melle, said: “Stimorol isn’t your regular gum. With distinctive flavours like liquorice, cinnamon and wild cherry, alongside mint, it’s undoubtedly for the Bold, for those who aren’t afraid to stand out. “Chew Bold” is our call to Gen Z to chew with confidence and feel secure in who they are, to belong without blending in.
AMV BBDO responded to our brief with a clever brand strategy brought to life with a bold creative idea. We think our boxing sloth is really going to resonate with audiences and win over a whole new generation for the iconic Stimorol brand.”
Helena Georghiou, Managing Partner at AMV BBDO said: “It’s so great that Gen Z is changing the script about what it means to belong, and it ties in with Stimorol’s longstanding reputation for being the chewing gum of choice for those of a bold disposition. The sloth isn’t the most obvious idea, but it’s one which is going to help Stimorol stand out amid the usual chewing gum tropes and delight the Gen Z audience PVM wants to reach.”

records.title: Choc Chip Cookie launch goes 'full cookie'
records.campaign_title: Choc Chip Cookie launch goes 'full cookie'
records.description:
Australia is about to ‘go full cookie’ with the launch of Maxibon’s new Choc Chip Cookie Bon in a new integrated campaign via SICKDOGWOLFMAN which asks the classic age-old philosophical question, ‘What happens if a person turns into a cookie?’

In short, they freak out and scream ‘I’m a cookie!’ before their mate rushes in to help, only to become distracted by how delicious they look and attempt take a bite out of their new cookie-shaped friend while they plead ‘Don’t eat me!’

Directed by Revolver’s Matt Devine, to make the transformation believable the production team partnered with Sharp FX to build a full prosthetic cookie suit from scratch. The cookie, the choc chips, the cracks, the arms, the legs, the head, everything. And it had to be mobile enough to perform a TikTok dance.

The campaign extends beyond the hero film with a series of social-first content pieces across TikTok and Meta imagining the day-to-day struggles of living life as a cookie. From housemate arguments over trails of crumbs, to your mate quietly dipping your fingers in a glass of milk, the content explores the understandably chaotic reality of a biscuit-based existence.

A first-of-its-kind launch for Maxibon in Australia, the Choc Chip Cookie features a cookie dough flavoured slab loaded with choc chips, sandwiched between two choc chip cookies on one end and dipped in chocolate with extra cookie pieces on the other.

records.title: Christopher Street Roblox experience for Pride
records.campaign_title: Christopher Street Roblox experience for Pride
records.description:
To celebrate Pride month this year, got2b and Jung von Matt NERD are bringing New York’s iconic Christopher Street – the epicentre of all Pride celebrations and deeply associated with the LGBTQIA+ rights movement– to Roblox for the first time. 

Christopher Street is an iconic street in New York City's West Village, famed for being the site of the Stonewall Inn, a bar that sparked the Stonewall Riots in 1969, which ignited the modern LGBTQIA+ rights movement. 

Paying tribute to the origins of Pride, got2b and JvM NERD are immersing gamers in Christopher Street in 1969, where they can learn about the protests, empowerment and liberation – everything Pride is about. 

JvM NERD has devised ‘CSD OBBY by got2b’, two immersive Roblox games, that bring the history of the LGBTQIA+ movement closer to the gaming community – in particular Gen Z and Gen Alpha gamers. 

The first mini game features an obstacle course inspired by the iconic rainbow flag. During the game, players can explore the story behind the flag’s symbolism and impact. Each level represents a rainbow flag colour and its meaning - for example, orange for healing and red for life - with obstacles reflecting these themes.  

The second mini game in the got2b Roblox metaverse centres on Stonewall. Players immerse themselves in the year 1969 and must overcome many challenges and barriers, symbolising the discrimination and social repression the activists faced. Throughout the Roblox obby, they encounter historical references, key events and important figures associated with the community. 

JVM NERD was responsible for the development of the game design, lore and supporting communication strategy, ALFR3D, JvM NERD’s tech division, supporting strategy, mechanics and UGC creators. 

To celebrate Pride month, ‘CSD OBBY by got2b’ will be released globally on June 5th and will be available throughout the entire month.  

The project aims to educate and inform younger players about the origins of Pride, as well as its significance for the LGBTQIA+ community and their allies.

records.title: Cinco de Mayo - Taco Totality
records.description:
Cinco de Mayo and Taco Tuesday Fall on the Same Day as Old El Paso Celebrates Rare “Taco Totality” with Exclusive Merch and Tacos for Fans Nationwide.

To help everyone make the most of the rare taco eclipse on May 5, Old El Paso is debuting limited-edition gear designed to enhance every bite and new Old El Paso Stand ‘N Stuff Taco Shells with the flavor of TABASCO® Brand Pepper Sauce.

​An Old El Paso “Taco Totality” gift box is displayed against a starry, space-themed background, open to reveal taco-inspired items including a neck pillow, protective glasses, and Tabasco taco shells. The image highlights the brand’s limited-edition gear and new product launch celebrating the rare alignment of Cinco de Mayo and Taco Tuesday.

For the first time since 2020, Cinco de Mayo and Taco Tuesday fall on the same day, creating what Old El Paso is calling “Taco Totality,” a rare taco eclipse where two taco-filled occasions align – and won’t again until 2037.  

To help everyone get ready for the taco eclipse, Old El Paso tapped actor Randy Havens, known for his role as a beloved science teacher in a popular sci-fi drama, to explain the rare taco phenomenon through a series of short educational social videos. 

Anyone planning their Taco Totality menu can stock up on Old El Paso favorites, including shells, beans, sauces, rice and the new out-of-this-world Old El Paso Stand ‘N Stuff Taco Shells and Taco Seasoning made with the flavor of TABASCO® Brand Pepper Sauce, available now nationwide. And since Taco Totality only comes around once in a while, limited time offers like “Save for Cinco” on Ibotta and bonus points on Fetch make it easier to go back for seconds (or thirds).

records.title: Claim Your Space
records.description:
The world has a long history of telling women to be smaller. Be quieter. Be less. But like hair, we were never meant to act flat or stay in place. Determined to challenge those expectations, Nexxus® is launching "Claim Your Space," a new campaign featuring breakout star Ciara Miller that celebrates the defiant power of presence — and it all starts with the brand's newest innovation in the brand's Styling & Finishing Line. The Nexxus AIR SHAPE™ Workable Hold Texture Spray is here to add and hold the airy volume you need to help you unapologetically claim your space in both your hair and your life.

Ciara Miller Claims Her Space with Nexxus

As an entrepreneur, reality TV star, and woman who refuses to shrink when the spotlight gets hot, Ciara is the perfect partner for a campaign and product line designed to take your confidence to the next level. And fresh off the heels of a highly publicized television finale where she masterfully reclaimed her space and power, she's standing taller than ever. In a new, social-first spot debuting June 10 and later hitting digital billboards and streaming platforms, Ciara will be taking over the city streets to show what happens when volume becomes presence, hair becomes attitude, and confidence literally changes the scale of the world around her.

The magic behind it all? The AIR SHAPE™ Workable Hold Texture Spray, aka flat hair's worst nightmare. Think: 48 hours of touchable texture and hold for that perfect, done-but-undone style.

"Over the years, I've learned that true confidence isn't about being the loudest voice in the room," said Ciara. "Self-assurance comes with owning who you are and never apologizing for it. That's why I'm so excited to be partnering with Nexxus, a brand that empowers women to take up space. My hair has always been a huge reflection of how I show up in the world, and using the AIR SHAPE™ Workable Hold Texture Spray gives it the volume and hold it needs to match my energy. Because if I'm no longer holding myself back to fit in, my hair shouldn't either!"

The "Claim Your Space" campaign will continue to dominate social feeds with an exclusive "red carpet" vignette rolling out shortly after the ad's debut. These digital clips will feature Ciara moving through a world that literally expands around her. But this isn't just her world — Nexxus is inviting every woman who refuses to blend into the background to step into a space where their presence is even more visible, showcasing how the lift of AIR SHAPE™ Workable Hold Texture Spray empowers anyone to shift the energy of a room.

The Science Behind the Space You Take

The fan-favorite Nexxus Styling & Finishing Line has entered a new era with sleek, revamped packaging and a commitment to protein protective styling. Leading this evolution is the brand's new hero innovation — the AIR SHAPE™ Workable Hold Texture Spray. Together, the collection is designed to help you claim your space with weightless, larger-than-life hair. The ultimate goal? To prove that the confidence to command a room has always been in your DNA. Now, it's in your hair, too.

"Historically, the world has tried to dim the light of women everywhere by pressuring them to be smaller and quieter, but with 'Claim Your Space,' Nexxus is actively working to change that narrative," added Lynn Fischer, Head of Brand, Nexxus North America. "Partnering with Ciara was a natural choice because she perfectly captures what happens when visible, larger-than-life confidence and inner strength come together. The entire Styling & Finishing Line, including the new AIR SHAPE™ Workable Hold Texture Spray, was designed to help our consumers channel that same unapologetic power."

records.title: Clampy
records.description:
The Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) is tackling vehicle tax evasion with a new campaign created by AMV BBDO. The launch marks the agency’s first work for the DVLA.
The humorous campaign introduces a new character inspired by one of the DVLA’s most recognisable enforcement tools: the wheel clamp. Affectionately known as “Clampy”, the character stars in two 20-second films that speak directly to vehicle owners who have failed to tax their vehicles.
In the first film, Clampy bemoans John for attempting to dodge taxing his car. Chancing it leaves Clampy stuck to John’s vehicle and in the firing line of a passing dog that cocks its leg. Clampy’s troubles don’t stop there. In the second film, he misses his son’s birthday party after absent-minded Leanne forgets to tax her vehicle.
Both films end with the car owner coming into view and sighing with frustration when they spot the clamp, playfully dramatising the disruptive reality of forgetting or dodging vehicle tax.
Directed by Florence Poppy Deary through Biscuit, the campaign runs across social media including Meta and Reddit, YouTube and other online video platforms, out-of-home, and audio until 31 March.
The campaign premiered on audio and out-of-home on 26 January, followed by social and online video on 10 February.
Daniel Wood, Head of External Communications at DVLA, said: “This campaign brings a key enforcement route, clamping, to life in a relatable way. Most motorists tax on time, but when they don’t, the consequences can be significant, including having their vehicle clamped. The campaign highlights how quick and easy it is to tax your vehicle online - and paying by Direct Debit can help motorists stay on top of renewals and avoid meeting Clampy.”
Ben Edwards, Executive Creative Director, AMV BBDO: “We’re hugely proud that Clampy is our first campaign for the DVLA. Every person he’s met along the creative gauntlet has added something to him, until he became this funny, strange, slightly sad character we all feel incredibly fond of. Hopefully, everyone who sees him out and about feels the same as us and that he makes people think twice about risking not taxing their vehicle, and acts as a gentle reminder for those likely to forget.”

records.title: Clarityne entiende a los alérgicos (Clarityne Gets Allergy Sufferers)
records.campaign_title: Clarityne entiende a los alérgicos (Clarityne Gets Allergy Sufferers)
records.description:
When you truly understand allergy sufferers, you realize their symptoms often look like something else.
Tears don’t mean they’re emotional.
A red nose doesn’t mean they’ve been crying.
And a blocked nose doesn’t mean they have a cold.

With a limited budget and only stock footage available, we turned that constraint into the idea itself. We searched for stock videos featuring the same actor and built three different stories around their “misunderstood” symptoms.

Each film reframes what we see on screen, revealing that what seems emotional or dramatic is actually just allergies — until Clarityne steps in.

The solution is announced through a distinctive sonotype that cuts through the moment, shouting “CLARITYNEEEE,” turning misunderstanding into relief.

A simple idea that proves Clarityne doesn’t just treat allergies.
It understands them.

records.title: Coach Gundy
records.description:
Big wireless bills are enough to make anyone rant. Just ask world renowned internet ranting football coach Mike Gundy. The famed Oklahoma State head coach reprised his 2007 “I’m a man, I’m 40” press conference moment on behalf of Consumer Cellular Inc, this time redirecting his fury at overpriced phone plans instead of sports reporting. 

The :30s spot – part cultural parody, part generational rallying cry – was crafted by creative AOR THE MAYOR to put a humorous spin on a sports milestone that Gen X fans will never forget. 

“Coach Gundy’s ‘I’m 40’ moment isn’t just iconic—it’s inseparable from age and a moment in time.” said Carter Nance, VP of Brand at Consumer Cellular. “That makes it the perfect platform for Consumer Cellular to show fellow 50+ sports fans why we’re the smart alternative to Big Wireless.”

Coach Grundy is no longer 40, and as his fans cross into their 50s, CCI is reminding them they’re not too young to save.
Coach Gundy makes aging a badge of pride. You get tougher, smarter, and more savings-savvy with age. In the spot, Coach channels the same passion that made his 2007 rant famous, declaring that Big Wireless rate hikes “make him wanna puke” and urging fans to see how much they can cut from their bills by switching to Consumer Cellular.
First launched on X by sports reporter Brett McMurphy, Gundy 2025 will run during related college football programming nationwide, including a high-profile TV debut during the Oregon vs. Oklahoma State game on 9.6.
On X, the spot has already blown up, generating over 1 million views in a day.

This marks the latest work from CCI and THE MAYOR’s ongoing partnership, which continues to leverage cultural moments and beloved talent to speak directly to audiences over 50. From Ted Danson to NASCAR, The Masters, and now, college football, the brand’s ongoing creative collaborations prove that saving money doesn’t mean sacrificing fun, relevance, or fandom.

“Coach Gundy’s press conference rant is one of those cultural moments for college football fans,” said Tom Hamling, Founder and CCO of THE MAYOR. “It’s basically a 20 year old meme that resurfaces every year. So, we loved the idea of revisiting it - not just for nostalgia sake, but to make 50+ people stop and think that if Coach made the change to CCI…maybe I should, too.” 

Gundy 2025 will run across TV, digital, and socials, throughout the season, ensuring football fans everywhere are reminded that it pays to switch to Consumer Cellular once you hit the big 5-0. THE MAYOR has worked in partnership with CCI since early 2024 to support the brand in their mission to be the most beloved wireless company in the nation.

records.title: Coco Gauff x New Naked
records.description:
Naked Smoothie's Chief Smoothie Officer, Coco Gauff, is back to introduce the world to the New Naked with a series of lighthearted, tennis-world moments. Co-starring is her ever-enthusiastic––but often misguided––sidekick Smoothie Boy. Set on the court, the spots use playful miscommunication to spotlight New Naked’s refreshed packaging and boosted benefits, bringing the brand’s cheeky personality to life. 

Across the spots, Smoothie Boy tries his hardest to keep up with the news––but keeps getting it hilariously wrong. Each mix-up becomes a playful way of reinforcing what the campaign sets out to do: make the new look and boosted benefits of New Naked unmistakably clear to everyone (even Smoothie Boy). 

Developed in partnership with Dentsu Creative and dentsu X, the campaign is running through the end of March, with assets expected to stay in paid rotation for most of the year. The work spans Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. 

Having collaborated with Coco previously, the team leaned into what resonates most authentically on set: her ability to laugh, play, and poke fun at moments from the perspective of a tennis athlete.

records.title: Coffee Sinners
records.description:
L'OR is inviting coffee lovers to step into the confessional with the launch of "Coffee Sinners," the first global campaign created by GUT Madrid for the brand. Launching first in France, followed by Spain, Switzerland, and Australia, among others, the campaign introduces L'OR Espresso Concentrate while celebrating the start of a new creative partnership between GUT and JDE Peet's, the world's leading pure play coffee company. 
Built on the insight that coffee is full of unwritten rules and expectations, "Coffee Sinners" challenges coffee purists and their idea of doing coffee the “right” way. It celebrates the reality that everyone has a coffee habit someone else would call a sin, reframing it as freedom rather than fault. By reimagining the confessional phrase "Forgive me, coffee, for I have sinned," the campaign turns these rituals into badges of pride, inviting people to remix, customize, and enjoy coffee entirely on their own terms.
"Coffee Sinners" signals a new creative era for L'OR, evolving its premium heritage into a younger, more contemporary voice rooted in creativity, cultural relevance, and self expression. As the first campaign from the partnership between L'OR and GUT Madrid, it introduces a modern visual language and a renewed way for the brand to connect with a new generation of coffee lovers. Launching alongside L'OR Espresso Concentrate in Pure Black, Sweet & Rich Mocha, and Sweet Caramel, the campaign showcases a product designed to unlock endless coffee combinations, reinterpreting L'OR’s world through exaggerated serves, playful religious references, and a bold aesthetic that turns every coffee sin into something worth celebrating.
"Coffee culture has long been shaped by rituals and conventions, but today's consumers are increasingly looking for ways to make experiences their own," said Ellen van der Linde, Global Marketing Manager at L'OR. "We believe coffee should be about pleasure, not pressure. With L'OR Espresso Concentrate, we're inviting people to break coffee's unwritten rules, explore their creativity, and enjoy coffee on their own terms. 'Coffee Sinners' celebrates everyone who dares to reinvent the ritual and make every coffee moment uniquely their own."
“We love coffee. And we love coffee purists too (some of us are among them). But as much as we love them and their rules, we also enjoyed breaking those rules for a little while to make this campaign. We must confess." said Ramiro Gamallo, Chief Creative Officer at GUT Madrid.
Launching across TV, digital, social media, and out of home in France, Spain, Switzerland, Australia and more, "Coffee Sinners" introduces L'OR Espresso Concentrate through a campaign that turns coffee rituals into playful acts of self expression, inviting consumers everywhere to proudly embrace their coffee sins.

records.title: Colonoscopy Reminder
records.description:
“Colonoscopy Reminder” is a provocative and deeply personal campaign that ditches the clinical for the visceral, in support of the new documentary “Andre is an Idiot, from Joint Venture. The campaign was created and executed by Mekanism. The campaign was created in collaboration with the distribution company, Joint Venture to support the release of their new documentary “Andre is an Idiot,” a raw, final testament from Andre Riccardi, who documented his terminal battle with colon cancer to ensure others wouldn’t follow in his footsteps. 

André Ricciardi spent over a decade at Mekanism, where he worked alongside both the film’s producer – his longtime best friend – and its director. “Andre is an Idiot” was a major winner at the 2025 Sundance Film Festival, taking home two prestigious awards: Audience Award: U.S. Documentary and Jonathan Oppenheim Editing Award: U.S. Documentary. It received a score of 93% on Rotten Tomatoes. 

The hero :30 film pairs a whimsical, charming melody with a curated gallery of objects, from bundt cakes to balloon ends, that serve as everyday “asshole” lookalikes. From oranges to tree knots, the film is a cheeky reminder to take care of our health as the lyrics from the melody sing, “Everything Reminds Me of You.” 

In addition to the film, Joint Venture and Mekanism are sharing boxes filled with items from the film, like fruit and balloons, with QR code stickers on each item that link straight to the documentary film and microsite. The boxes will also include postcards with images from the campaign to send colonoscopy reminders to friends and family. Influencers like Dr. Tim Tiutan, an internet viral internal medicine doctor, and other creators will receive one of the boxes.

While the work naturally bridges to the film’s launch, the core objective remains a singular rallying cry: encouraging the next generation to get screened. More than just a PSA, the campaign was created in support of the documentary, extending its impact beyond the screen and helping carry its message into culture. Grounded in a deeply personal connection to see the film and its subject matter, the work brings urgency and emotional weight that transcends traditional advertising. It’s not a standalone brand effort, but a purpose-driven extension of the film itself – a movement born from real life, designed to amplify real-life impact.

Mekanism’s CEO Jason Harris and Chief Creative Officer Tommy Means also appear in the documentary, further underscoring the agency’s authentic connection to and support of the film’s mission. The campaign is live across social, website, and wild postings. The full documentary, “Andre is an Idiot,” premieres in New York City at the Film Forum on March 5, 2026.

records.title: Come Back to Earth
records.description:
In a world dominated by screens and technology, most of us are disconnected from the physical world. Enter: Miracle-Gro, a brand uniquely positioned to help people reset and bring them back to gardening and all the benefits of nature.

With the help of its creative agency Orchard, the brand is launching a new campaign called “Come Back to Earth”—an invitation to leave behind modern-day stress and reject technology overloads in favor of returning to nature.  

The first seeds of the campaign will take root with a unique, 24-hour social-first activation that will roll out throughout Earth Day (Apr 22). Starting at midnight, the activation uses found objects, clever production, and a powerful strategic insight to remind people of the beneficial impact plants can have on our digital-first and systemized lives.  The series, a precursor to more “Come Back to Earth” creative slated for May, leans into the visceral nature of gardening, celebrating the act as a simple, accessible way to re-engage with the world through all the senses. Throughout Earth Day, the brand will release 24 social posts across Instagram, published every hour on the hour. Every post is a suggestion to snap out of the technological world and connect with plants.

The activation was produced in a uniquely fast and deeply inventive way by Orchard’s in-house team, without the use of any AI. The team purposefully chose to keep this as real as gardening itself by crafting each scene by hand, matching plants to devices in unique ways, like thyme and a smart watch, for example.

Going from concept to launch in just two weeks, Orchard conceptualized, shot, and edited the project completely in-house, with their lead Maker Editor, Cory Souto, shooting the work with Sr. Art Director Ashley Crouch and Copywriter Bryan Allman.  

In that short time, the Orchard team had to source all 24 of the “planters” featured in the series, simultaneously conceptualizing the best way to style each one to showcase nature overtaking technology.

records.title: Comfort on Display at LA Furniture Store
records.campaign_title: Comfort on Display at LA Furniture Store
records.description:
Mario Capasa opens its newest location in the heart of West Hollywood, CA. From the street, the building reads more like a contemporary gallery than a furniture store— a deliberate gesture to frame the brand as part of the design world, not of the retail world.

The Material Proof Bar transforms customization into an exhibition. Stretching along one wall, it combines a full-scale swatch display with interactive demos that reveal how modular sofas perform in daily life.  Visitors can see stains bead and wipe clean, watch breathability and heat-dissipation measured in real time, and feel abrasion resistance put to the test.

Beyond performance, the station invites tailoring at every level. With more than fifty sofa cover options and a framework of interchangeable components, each sofa becomes a system designed around its owner— by a platform where proof and personalization are made visible.

This editorial-style video was distributed across platforms such as YouTube, Google My Business, and Facebook Business Pages, each optimized for local search to drive foot traffic and online engagement. To enhance the overall impact, high-end retail interior photography was incorporated into business listings and social media, capturing detailed shots of the store's layout and product displays. The integration of video and photography into geolocation platforms like Apple Maps and Bing Places further boosts local SEO, reinforcing the store’s credibility and appeal, making it an essential stop for local shoppers.  

Hailed by leading design publications as “the most comfortable seating imaginable,” Mario Capasa’s Los Angeles flagship unfolds like an exhibition. The effect is a showroom that reads as a gallery of possibilities, each sofa staged as a medium within a larger composition, where comfort becomes the subject and the real work on display is the way you live.

records.title: Commitment Hearts
records.description:
Sweethearts, the OG Valentine's Day candy, is once again leaning into current dating trends with conversation hearts that mean what they say—using scannable AI technology. New research reveals 83% of younger Americans have moved past the blurry "situationships" the beloved brand commemorated with last year's limited-edition run of "Situationship Boxes." Hence this year's encore V-Day surprise. Now, consumers can scan actual Sweethearts candies via sweetheartscandies.com to access moving trucks, marriage licenses and even matching heart-shaped headstones—for lovers who want something really concrete.

Sweethearts, the OG Valentine’s Day candy, is once again leaning into current dating trends with conversation hearts that mean what they say--using scannable AI technology. Now, consumers can scan actual Sweethearts candies via a mobile device to access moving trucks, marriage licenses and even matching heart-shaped headstones--for lovers who want something really concrete.
Sweethearts, the OG Valentine’s Day candy, is once again leaning into current dating trends with conversation hearts that mean what they say--using scannable AI technology. Now, consumers can scan actual Sweethearts candies via a mobile device to access moving trucks, marriage licenses and even matching heart-shaped headstones--for lovers who want something really concrete.

Experience the full interactive Multichannel News Release here: https://www.multivu.com/Sweethearts/9307051-en-sweethearts-candies-mean-what-they-say-this-valentines-day

"Sweethearts conversation hearts are 'Commitment Hearts,'" said Evan Brock, vice president of marketing for Spangler Candy Company. "We've come full circle from embracing ambiguity with last year's Situationship Boxes to helping today's singles define their relationships with America's much-loved Valentine's Day candy."

According to the survey, both Gen Z (84%) and millennials (82%) have had their fill of relationships that lack commitment or clear definition. In fact, 92% of survey participants wish their partners actually said what they mean rather than sending mixed messages.

That's why Sweethearts is utilizing artificial intelligence to render its candy hearts scannable via mobile devices. Messages like "MOVE IN?", "MARRY ME" and "4EVER EVER?" take users to websites where they can book a move through Piece of Cake Moving & Storage, get married online through Courtly or buy heart-shaped headstones if they truly mean "'til death do us part." All consumers have to do is purchase a box or bag of Sweethearts and scan the hearts with a mobile device at sweetheartscandies.com.

In 2025, both Gen Z and millennials hope to reach relationship milestones such as committing to a serious relationship (39%) or falling in love for the first or even final time (34%). And Sweethearts is here for it.

Survey methodology: Sweethearts surveyed 1,000 Gen Z and 1,000 millennials who are single or casually dating; the survey was administered and conducted online between Nov. 27 and Dec. 2, 2024.

records.title: Connected in 3-2-1
records.description:
Despite living in a digital-first world, getting online is still a long and complicated process, involving complex set-ups, hidden fees and frustrating delays. Which is why a fast and flexible connection service can take users by surprise - as seen in a surreal new campaign for internet provider TADAAM, directed by Nitram through HAMLET and created by OONA/BAAS agency. 

Launching today, ‘Connected in 3-2-1’ humorously highlights the Belgian provider’s three cable-free solutions, which allow users to plug, play and connect on TV, internet or mobile - without any of the hassle associated with regular providers. 

The spot emphasises TADAAM’s USPs - 24-hour delivery, instant E-SIMs and no technicians - via a series of surreal scenarios in which unwary users are comically impacted by the unexpected speed and efficiency of their connection.  

Featuring surreal sets inspired by Swedish director Roy Andersson - known for his absurdist approach to humour - the films follow TADAAM users in a series of mundane situations, which are suddenly and dramatically disrupted by a TADAAM service. In one spot, a laptop user is blasted backwards at warp speed; in another, a TV erupts through the wall of a living room. Adding to the absurdist effect is a voiceover by an omniscient narrator, who introduces each unwary character and delivers a countdown to the TADAAM effect.     

Three of the spots focus on specific products - TV, internet and the newly-launched mobile service - while the fourth features an extended narrative showcasing a combination of TADAAM’s services.     

The campaign will run online and on television channels across Belgium.

records.title: Cook Like a Curry House
records.description:
Patak’s has launched a partnership with Mob as part of a new content-led campaign designed to demonstrate how easy it is to ‘cook like a curry house’ at home using Patak’s Spice Pastes. 

The collaboration was negotiated by independent media agency the7stars, and brings Patak’s together with Mob’s highly engaged, digital-first audience to inspire a new generation of home cooks. 

Mob has produced a series of videos featuring their talented chefs rustling up a selection of tasty recipes to showcase the versatility of Patak’s range of products and inspire the nation to bring the craft of a curry house into their homes using Patak’s Spice Paste. 

The first video, live today, sees chef Adam Bush creating a creamy chicken korma with cumin-spiced crispy naan croutons made with Patak’s Korma Paste Pot. This is followed by Sophie Wyburd cooking up a zingy veggie curry combining squash and halloumi with caramelised limes using Patak’s Tikka Masala Paste Pot. 

The activity will run across Mob’s website and social platforms, with recipe content appearing on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. The partnership is part of a broader integrated campaign, including an AV spot created by Ourselves, and spanning TV, VOD and YouTube, which launched on 19th January. VOD ad placement is handled through the7stars’ programmatic platform Prospero.

Chris Heyn, UK marketing director at Patak’s, said:
“Patak’s has always stood for making authentic, flavourful Indian cooking accessible at home. Partnering with Mob allows us to bring that to life in a contemporary, engaging way, showing people just how easy it is to cook like a curry house using our spice pastes.”

Zoe Bond, client lead at the7stars, added:
“Mob’s content-led approach and highly engaged community make it the perfect partner to help Patak’s connect with younger, socially native cooks. This collaboration brings together inspiring content, trusted creators and high-impact media to drive consideration and show the simplicity and versatility of Patak’s products.”

records.title: A saucy feature-length “Spaghetti Western” film
records.description:
Texas Pete® is serving up its first-ever feature-length film, blending a classic western parody with real spaghetti recipes, all starring the brand’s signature sauces. Created by creative AOR McKinney, the 53-minute film, “Texas Pete® Spaghetti Western,” continues the brand’s “Let Flavor Run Wild” platform by showing how Texas Pete® “brings bold to the bland,” even when dinner is something as familiar as spaghetti.

The story follows a cast of tongue-in-cheek characters including Johnny Alfredo, Clyde Carbonara, Deputy Al Dente and Ms. Mary Marinara, in a loving parody of classic Italian westerns. Guns are swapped for plates of spaghetti and duels unfold over dishes seasoned with Texas Pete®.

records.title: Core Strength Training
records.description:
True core strength isn't built by just crunches or planks. It's built through daily training that starts at your body's core: your gut. 

Culturelle Probiotics makes that daily gut training simple. Acting as your microbiome's personal trainer, keeping your health on track and building the kind of strength that compounds over time and powers everything you do.

To help consumers rethink the meaning of core strength, Culturelle appointed their first-ever Chief Wellness Ambassador—a recognizable face in fitness and wellness who knows that real strength doesn't start in the gym, but in the gut—Peloton Instructor Jess King. 

In her role as CWA, Jess championed daily gut health in culture-forward, relatable ways across broadcast, digital, and PR channels.

records.title: Crave Thy Castle
records.description:
White Castle, America’s first fast-food hamburger chain and the family-owned innovator behind The Original Slider®, is launching a new brand campaign titled “Crave Thy Castle.”
Created in partnership with newly-appointed AOR GSD&M, “Crave Thy Castle” personifies the White Castle superfan as a witty, tongue-in-cheek manifestation who appears whenever the craving hits, guiding people to the famous Sliders as the only true way to satisfy it.
Kicking off with two :30s and :15 cutdowns, the brand campaign targets younger audiences in retail aisles who may be ‘Crave Curious,’ a term coined to describe Gen Zers who are looking for bold bites, shareable moments, and brands that break the algorithm. 
In ‘Lunch Break,’ a woman settles in her office break room hungry and ready for lunch, when the spot reveals her doppelganger, a ‘Castle Craving’ knight outfitted in a traditional knight’s helmet, who brings her the iconic White Castle Sliders from the hot and ready microwave. The spot ends with the tagline “When Craving Strikes, Strike Back.” 
In ‘Stop Here,’ a man browsing the frozen foods aisle comes face-to-face with his own ‘Castle Craving,’ a look-alike knight that loads up his shopping cart with boxed frozen sliders. The spot concludes with the tagline “Your Castle Craving Knows Best.”
The initial executions focused on retail will run across CTV, OLV, display, radio, and social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Snap), including influencer partnerships. Rolling out through February, additional brand campaign elements will include:
White Castle and GSD&M transformed influencers across TikTok and Instagram into “Craving Catalysts,” who turn everyday moments, from late-night bites, mid-day snack runs, and game day eats, into content that makes White Castle cravings impossible to ignore. 
In an official partnership with DraftKings, White Castle will step into one of the biggest moments of the year: Super Bowl LX. 
With $5,000 in total cash prizes up for grabs, the White Castle “Crave Thy Victory” prediction contest reflects how the brand is showing up differently than ever before–not just for the game, but in the game, meeting net-gen fans where they compete and turning America’s biggest gameday into crave-worthy victory on the DraftKings Game Studio. 
In addition to the custom contest promotion, White Castle will have a custom landing page with brand integrations, co-branded emails and media, and robust social promotion.
The brand is also partnering with The Dan Le Batard Show by creating a custom roundtable segment focused on the best bets of the week. The segment will feature a White Castle slider being put into the microwave as a :60 countdown starts, participants then give their craveworthy commentary on sure fire bets of the week before the microwave dings and the frozen slides are ready to enjoy!
“Crave Thy Castle” marks the first work for the brand from GSD&M since being awarded the business in July 2025.

records.title: Crave Thy Castle
records.description:
White Castle, America’s first fast-food hamburger chain and the family-owned innovator behind The Original Slider®, is launching a new brand campaign titled “Crave Thy Castle.”
Created in partnership with newly-appointed AOR GSD&M, “Crave Thy Castle” personifies the White Castle superfan as a witty, tongue-in-cheek manifestation who appears whenever the craving hits, guiding people to the famous Sliders as the only true way to satisfy it.
Kicking off with two :30s and :15 cutdowns, the brand campaign targets younger audiences in retail aisles who may be ‘Crave Curious,’ a term coined to describe Gen Zers who are looking for bold bites, shareable moments, and brands that break the algorithm. 
In ‘Lunch Break,’ a woman settles in her office break room hungry and ready for lunch, when the spot reveals her doppelganger, a ‘Castle Craving’ knight outfitted in a traditional knight’s helmet, who brings her the iconic White Castle Sliders from the hot and ready microwave. The spot ends with the tagline “When Craving Strikes, Strike Back.” 
In ‘Stop Here,’ a man browsing the frozen foods aisle comes face-to-face with his own ‘Castle Craving,’ a look-alike knight that loads up his shopping cart with boxed frozen sliders. The spot concludes with the tagline “Your Castle Craving Knows Best.”
The initial executions focused on retail will run across CTV, OLV, display, radio, and social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Snap), including influencer partnerships. Rolling out through February, additional brand campaign elements will include:
White Castle and GSD&M transformed influencers across TikTok and Instagram into “Craving Catalysts,” who turn everyday moments, from late-night bites, mid-day snack runs, and game day eats, into content that makes White Castle cravings impossible to ignore. 
In an official partnership with DraftKings, White Castle will step into one of the biggest moments of the year: Super Bowl LX. 
With $5,000 in total cash prizes up for grabs, the White Castle “Crave Thy Victory” prediction contest reflects how the brand is showing up differently than ever before–not just for the game, but in the game, meeting net-gen fans where they compete and turning America’s biggest gameday into crave-worthy victory on the DraftKings Game Studio. 
In addition to the custom contest promotion, White Castle will have a custom landing page with brand integrations, co-branded emails and media, and robust social promotion.
The brand is also partnering with The Dan Le Batard Show by creating a custom roundtable segment focused on the best bets of the week. The segment will feature a White Castle slider being put into the microwave as a :60 countdown starts, participants then give their craveworthy commentary on sure fire bets of the week before the microwave dings and the frozen slides are ready to enjoy!
“Crave Thy Castle” marks the first work for the brand from GSD&M since being awarded the business in July 2025.

records.title: Cravings Can Happen Anywhere
records.description:
Cheez-It is debuting a new creative platform, “Cravings Can Happen Anywhere,” with a comedic campaign from FCB New York that explores how cravings can strike in the most unexpected (and inconvenient) moments. 

Building on the 2023 tagline Want It. Need It. Cheez-It., the new campaign leans into the brand’s signature “absurd irresistibility”—those all-consuming cravings that hijack everyday situations with no warning.

Each film dramatizes how a sudden Cheez-It craving can completely derail the moment—whether you’re in a live reading at book club, meeting your girlfriend’s dad, or giving a eulogy.

Directed by Clay Weiner of Superfriends, the spots use visual escalation and comedic timing to bring those interruptions to life.
Running across TV, OLV, CTV, and social media starting in September, with support across influencer, audio, and brand-owned channels.

records.title: Cricket Wireless Teams Up With WWE Superstar Jey Uso
records.campaign_title: Cricket Wireless Teams Up With WWE Superstar Jey Uso
records.description:
Cricket Wireless is teaming up with WWE’s Jey Uso in his first solo commercial to prove one thing: Cricket 5G is blazing fast just like Jey Uso. In the new campaign from Cricket’s agency of record ARGONAUT, Jey sets his sights on becoming the face of Cricket 5G, squaring up against the villains of the wireless world in a real-world video game showdown. 

In the spot, Jey makes his case to Cricket character Dante, on why he should be the face of Cricket 5G. The world around Jey and Dante is packed with easter eggs: from a wrestling mask shop in the background to a ‘Yeet’ Street sign and Jey and Dante rocking Jey’s signature ‘Yeet’ glasses, every detail is designed for fans who want in on the action. Together, they take on a crew of wireless villains, including Hidden Feez, Expensive Eddie, the Contract Sisters, and Surprise Sam.

"We were excited about the opportunity to partner up with ‘Main Event’ Jey Uso for this campaign,” says Erin Bishop, Lead Marketing Manager, Sponsorships, at Cricket Wireless. “Much like Jey, we believe Cricket is the main event of wireless. We're both fast, powerful, and reliable. It's a great tag team." 

Whether watching live, scrolling online, or debating storylines in real time, fans rely on their phones to stay connected. Cricket’s 5G powers that connection, making it the network built for fandom.

“We made this for the fans, so the campaign is an extension of Jey Uso and Dante's personalities,” says Hemant Anant Jain at ARGONAUT. “They tag team and bring the excitement of WWE to the street level and drive home the idea of Cricket 5G being blazing fast. And the fans will love the easter eggs that are packed in the film.”

The production company, Framestore, used a tech-forward approach to bring the campaign’s video game-inspired villains to life, combining AI-driven workflows with markerless motion capture for fluid, dynamic animation without the constraints of suits or trackers. By front-loading the process with Directed-AI—where artists remain in full creative control—this hybrid pipeline delivered high-quality visuals and creative agility far beyond standard consumer-grade AI tools.

The soundtrack used in the campaign is Jey Uso’s entry song called Main Event ish (Jey Uso), composed by WWE and Def Rebel.

The work launched during WWE’s Summer Slam on August 2nd and August 3rd on TV (USA Network) and social (with a pending Netflix buy in Q4).

records.title: Crunch is Back
records.description:
After nearly a decade out of the spotlight, Oatmeal Crisp is making a bold comeback, poised to take its place in kitchen cupboards across Canada. With General Mills’ continued focus on its cereal portfolio, this latest campaign by Cossette takes a fresh approach with three distinct yet interconnected TV spots, each capturing the same chaotic family breakfast from a different perspective: mom, dad, and the family dog.

Each family member's perspective features an inner monologue laced with sarcasm and relatable musings, revealing how a little bit of crunch from Oatmeal Crisp makes a difference—not just in their breakfast, but in how they see their world.

But what makes this campaign truly unique is how each ad functions both as a standalone 30- or 15-second spot and as part of a larger narrative across all three. Viewers can watch any one of them and get an entertaining snapshot. But when seen together, the full story unfolds in a way that feels fresh and unexpected. Most importantly, each spot reinforces how the Oatmeal Crisp’s crunch can make life’s unpredictable and messy mornings that much better.

records.title: Crunch!
records.description:
In another collaboration between SabaVision’s Creative Solutions team and the Badr brand, the focus was on addressing one of the brand’s key needs: showcasing Badr pickles in an appetizing and visually appealing way, while raising awareness about the difference between the two product lines — Grade 1 and Premium.

To meet this objective, we developed a concept that would both clearly highlight Badr’s unique edge and leave a lasting impression. At the heart of the idea was a musical script built around a familiar, catchy tune—tied to the campaign’s core slogan:
“Crunch — that’s the sound of every bite of Badr!”

The main campaign video was designed as a studio concert — with a creative twist:
Everyone on stage is biting into pickles.
The crisp "crunch" sound from each bite was woven into the music and rhythm of the performance, turning it into a sensory experience that conveyed deliciousness in a fun and memorable way.

Through this creative blend of sound and visuals, the campaign successfully delivered an enjoyable and lasting brand experience that resonated with the audience.

records.title: Cue The Dinner Dance
records.description:
Lily’s Kitchen has today launched its new multi-market campaign Cue The Dinner Dance™, developed in partnership with creative agency elvis. The campaign marks the agency’s first work for the brand since being appointed as lead creative agency in December 2024.

Lily’s Kitchen tasked elvis with creating a lovable brand campaign to build awareness and emotional connection with cat and dog parents aged 25-44, encouraging them to purchase Lily’s Kitchen’s premium natural pet food.

The ad, marking the brand’s first foray into TV advertising, captures the joy and excitement pets feel when Lily’s Kitchen proper food is on the menu. Through a series of charming ‘dinner dances’ performed by tap dancing and rockstar dogs, as well as salsa-ing and ballet dancing cats, the characterful spot comes to life with a bespoke music track produced by Guilt Free, that perfectly complements the vibrant energy of the pet cast.

The spot was produced via virtual production in collaboration with Quite Brilliant. This innovative approach allowed the team to shoot four unique kitchen locations within a single day, eliminating the need for multiple shoot days and extensive transportation, while significantly reducing the carbon footprint. The virtual production environment also provided a stress-free experience for the animals involved.

The multi-market campaign will run across TV, out of home, social and in-store channels. Markets include the UK, France, Italy, Portugal, Germany, Switzerland, Netherlands, Belgium and Finland. Media planning and buying was handled by The Specialist Works.

records.title: Dairy to Feel Smug About
records.description:
SMUG Dairy, the innovative hybrid dairy range from Kerry Consumer Foods, has launched a new campaign to show conscious dairy lovers that they don’t have to compromise on taste.

While many of today’s consumers are looking to cut back on dairy for health and environmental reasons, their love for the taste of their favourite products often makes the change a difficult one.

Created by BMB, the new work spotlights two characters, Jane and Larry, who have switched to SMUG and have no regrets. Jane knows she can still get the ooze in her cheese toastie and Larry has elevated his flat white - they are free of the dairy doubts that used to worry them and they even feel a little smug about it.

The new campaign, which breaks on 30 April and will run until the beginning of June, seeks to tackle the barriers to switching to SMUG, including scepticism over taste and misunderstanding of the product benefits.

The two 30” executions were directed by Joe Giacomet and the campaign will run on BVOD, digital and social media.

Vicky Southern, strategy, marketing and innovation director at Kerry Dairy Consumer Foods, says: “Smug is a new kind of dairy that fits with how people want to eat today – conscious but uncompromising. Larry and Jane have helped us show that choosing SMUG means you can ditch the dilemma without ditching dairy altogether.”

Dave Beattie, Creative Director at BMB, adds: “We wanted to capture that quiet moment of triumph – when you realise you’ve made the smarter switch – giving a little wink to why we’re called SMUG. Jane and Larry are loving life with SMUG, so it only felt right to let them bask in that well-earned, self-satisfied glow.”
 
SMUG, which launched last year, is a completely new product and category. The products are made from blending dairy & oat and are lower in saturated fat and carbon emission than standard dairy but with all the great taste. BMB also created the launch campaign, which showed a playful supermarket romance between cartons of oat and dairy milk that ended in the pair blending to create SMUG. There are 3 core product ranges – milk, cheese and butter.

records.title: Dancing Can
records.description:
30 years after the iconic “Dancing Man” ad, Guinness introduces a playful stop-motion film to showcase its innovative Nitrosurge device and cans

Guinness is inviting more people to experience the joy and communion of a perfect pint at home with its new campaign, “Dancing Can,” a modern nod to the beloved 1994 “Dancing Man” ad. This latest campaign highlights how the Guinness Nitrosurge device puts the power of a perfect pour directly into consumers' hands. Launched in Great Britain last year, the pocket-sized device uses ultrasonic technology to create the iconic surge with perfectly formed nitrogen bubbles delivering satisfyingly smooth Guinness every time, everywhere.

Developed in partnership with AMV BBDO, “Dancing Can” uses a stop-motion twist to capture the ritual of pouring a perfect pint of Guinness, featuring a ‘dancing’ Nitrosurge can and device. The device is activated by clipping it onto the top of a Guinness Nitrosurge can, before pushing the button and pouring. The resulting pour is unmistakably Guinness, with its iconic dark liquid and creamy domed head. 

The 30-second hero film, directed by Johnny Kelly and produced by BAFTA-winning Nexus Studios, was shot using is a blend of live-action and stop-motion techniques. Set to the lively “Guaglione” track by Perez Prado, just as in the 1994 ad, the spot celebrates the quality and cheer of enjoying the perfect pour at home while highlighting the charm and innovation of the product.

Anna MacDonald, Guinness GB Marketing Director, said, “We wanted to translate the excitement and desirability of the Nitrosurge device, that gives Guinness fans an enhanced pouring experience which delivers beautiful, great tasting Guinness, every time. It’s a true celebration of innovation, in a fun and engaging way.”

AMV BBDO creative team behind the campaign Anzhela Hayrabedyan and Luca Grosso said, “Whether it’s a person or a can, 30 years later, the excitement and joy of watching the liquid settle into the perfect pint of Guinness still rings true. The unique charm and craft of stop-frame animation was the answer to bring this emotion to life."

Johnny Kelly, Director at Nexus Studios, said, “The original ‘Dancing Man’ video is one of my all-time favourite pieces of advertising, so it was a complete pleasure and terror to dance in its footprints. But I think our animator answered that conclusively. Our Guinness Can has moves I could only dream of.”

The campaign will run across Great Britain on TV, online, and social platforms in various formats, including 30, 20, 15, and 6-second versions, ensuring widespread reach and engagement .

records.title: Day Ones, Plus Two
records.description:
What if saying yes to a date didn't mean saying no to your friends?

This month, Tinder Canada launched Day Ones, Plus Two, a new influencer led campaign spotlighting Double Date, a feature that lets friends match and chat with other pairs together, making dating feel more social, comfortable, and low-pressure.

Canadian Gen Z daters are craving a social summer with their friends after months indoors. Double Date meets that moment, making meeting someone new feel like part of the plan rather than a distraction from it.

Created in partnership with strategic social agency AntiSocial, the campaign is rolling out across paid and organic social through a mix of brand creative and creator-led content in both English and French.

Together, the work positions Tinder as a fun, easy way to meet someone new without missing out on the people you already want to spend time with.
